verdict.rationale: The only versioning evidence is the `/v1/` prefix on the documented task-polling endpoint (`GET /v1/tasks/{id}`), backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec the probe confirms is live. That points to a versioned HTTP API. Nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme or any deprecation policy. missing for 10: documented API versioning policy (e.g., version headers or dated versions), published deprecation/sunset policy and timelines, changelog of breaking changes, independent corroboration.
